founderIntro.label: Who we are
founderIntro.title: Meet Kate HD.
founderIntro.body:
I am Kate Hibbs Davis, or Kate HD. At High Definition Advisors, I help organizations move beyond the fuzzy, uncertain phases of growth to find absolute clarity.

My superpower is the ability to see across every facet of an organization (programs, revenue, administration, and external affairs) and synthesize these diverse viewpoints into a single, actionable roadmap.
founderIntro.photoAlt: Kate Hibbs Davis, Founder and Principal of High Definition Advisors

hdCallout.label: Why “HD”?
hdCallout.body: It started with my initials, Kate HD. It stuck because it describes the work: bringing every part of your organization into sharp, high-definition focus.

challengesIntro.label: What we hear
challengesIntro.title: Growth outpaced the structure built to hold it.
challengesIntro.intro: The leaders we work with are not short on talent or commitment. They are stretched across an organization that grew faster than its foundation.

challenges.title: Growth outpaced structure
challenges.body: The mission grew faster than the systems, roles, and governance meant to carry it.

challenges.title: Revenue is concentrated
challenges.body: A few funders or a single program carry too much of the budget, and everyone feels the risk.

challenges.title: Roles have blurred
challenges.body: Talented people cover the gaps, decisions stall, and leadership spends its days reacting.

challenges.title: The story is scattered
challenges.body: Every team describes the work a little differently, so partners and funders hear a different organization each time.

shift.title: What changes when there is a plan.

points: Chasing the next grant or opportunity

intentional.label: With a roadmap

points: A funding mix built for stability

lensesTeaser.title: We see the whole organization, then build one plan.
